title: White House pulls FDA nominee Heidi Overton after wavering support from Senate Republicans
summary: The White House has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration. The move late Tuesday followed growing signs that Overton did not have the votes to win Senate confirmation. The top Republican on the Senate health committee said he was undecided on whether to support Overton ahead of a key vote set for Wednesday. Overton faced questions from Sen. Bill Cassidy and other senators about her approach to vaccines after she backed a controversial proposal to break up combination shots for children.
